newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rig count rose 12 to 999 this week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rig count rose 12 to 999 this week.

text.p: The number of rigs exploring for oil and natural gas in the United States stood rose to 999 this week from 987 last week, oilfield services company Baker Hughes Inc. said Friday.
A year ago there were 805 rigs at work. The weekly count reflects rigs exploring for but not producing oil and gas.
The number of rigs drilling on land rose by 10 to 848, while rigs working offshore rose to at 125. The number of rigs active in inland waters rose to 26.
Among the individual states, the biggest changes occurred in Texas, where the number of rigs rose 19, Oklahoma, which was down by 6, and Louisiana, which was up by four.

A total of 417 rigs were exploring for crude oil, down 12 from last week. The number of rigs searching for gas rose by 25 to 580, while the number of miscellaneous drilling projects now stands at two, down by one from last week.
There were 238 rigs drilling directionally, 67 drilling horizontally and 694 drilling vertically.
In Canada, the number of working rigs fell by 14 to 406, compared with 261 a year ago.
